title: Blackwell FP8 lane on the only available Ada device: unsupported
command: python tools/verify_blackwell_fp8.py --arch auto (RTX 4060 Ti, Ada sm_89)
notes: The lane is a hardware gate, not a pass: a non-Blackwell device is recorded as unsupported and exits 2. The page quotes this as proof that no Blackwell result exists.
